draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Mollem! This small village at the foot of the Sahyadri mountains is the main way into Bhagwan Mahaveer Sanctuary and Mollem National Park.
draft.hungryLine: Mollem is a small village on the highway, so keep meals simple before you head into the forest.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The village sits at the start of Anmod Ghat, right where you enter Bhagwan Mahaveer Sanctuary and Mollem National Park.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Slow down in the village itself, about a 7 min walk from here, with the Sahyadri foothills all around.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The name is said 'mole', because the final m is silent.

tips.title: Say it like a local.
tips.body: It's pronounced 'mole', since the last m is silent.

tips.title: Start your forest trip here.
tips.body: Mollem is the primary entry point for Bhagwan Mahaveer Sanctuary and Mollem National Park.

story.title: Sahyadri foothills
story.body: Mollem grew up in the foothills of the Sahyadri mountain range, near what is now the border with Karnataka.

story.title: Gateway to Anmod Ghat
story.body: The village sits on NH4 right where the road begins its climb up Anmod Ghat towards Karnataka.

story.title: Into the wild
story.body: Mollem falls under the Dharbandora block and is the main entry point for Bhagwan Mahaveer Sanctuary and Mollem National Park.
